title: Auqib Nabi makes his mark in New Zealand, finishes ODI series with 5 wickets

ai.summary: Cricket player Auqib Nabi Dar from Jammu and Kashmir finished India's ODI series against New Zealand with five wickets across four matches.

facts.claim: finished India's ODI series against New Zealand with five wickets across four matches
facts.quote: Srinagar, Nov 15: For Jammu and Kashmir's cricketing fraternity, Auqib Nabi Dar's performances in India's just concluded ODI series against New Zealand offer another reason for pride, with the fast bowler finishing the five-match contest with five wickets from four appearances.
